Pricing & Quotes

Most general-line distributors mark up product to cover their overhead — warehousing, sales teams, and logistics — and pass that cost to you. GHLS actively sources in the categories we specialize in, which allows us to identify pricing that standard distributors either don't have access to or choose not to pass along. Our clinic partners typically see savings of 15–30% versus what they were paying before switching.

Use our quote request form to tell us what you need — products, estimated volume, and timeline. We'll respond within one business day with itemized pricing and pack size options. There's no commitment required to receive a quote.

All quote requests submitted on business days receive a response within one business day. Requests submitted after hours or over weekends are responded to the next business day. For urgent needs, you can also call us directly at (555) 000-0000.

We don't publish pricing publicly because it varies based on product configuration, volume, and current market conditions. Pricing is provided directly in your quote and is specific to your order. This also ensures you're always getting our most current pricing rather than a number that may have changed.

Ordering & Minimums

We work with your actual usage volume rather than forcing arbitrary bulk thresholds on you. Minimums vary by product — most items ship in standard pack sizes (e.g., 25 or 100 units per kit), but we can discuss volume options during the quote process. We won't require you to over-order just to qualify for reasonable pricing.

Yes. We handle Women's Health and Medical Diagnostics products in the same quote and on the same order. Just indicate all the products you're interested in on your quote request and we'll price everything together.

Once you've reviewed your quote and are ready to proceed, simply reply to the quote email or contact your dedicated rep directly. They'll handle the order confirmation, payment terms, and shipment coordination from there.

Compliance & Documentation

Yes — 100% of our inventory is FDA-cleared or FDA-authorized. We do not source outside regulated channels under any circumstances. If a product doesn't meet full regulatory requirements, it's not in our catalog. Your clinic's compliance is not something we treat as a variable.

Every order ships with lot numbers, expiration dates, and chain of custody documentation included — automatically, without you having to request it. This makes CLIA and compliance audits straightforward and ensures your team always has the documentation they need on file.

The majority of rapid diagnostic tests we carry are available in CLIA-waived formats — meaning they can be run in-office without laboratory-grade instrumentation or a lab director. Where CLIA-waived options exist, we'll always indicate that clearly. If you have specific CLIA requirements, mention them in your quote request and we'll confirm compatibility.

Products

We specialize in two categories: Women's Health (pregnancy tests, ovulation/LH tests, fertility diagnostics, OB/GYN exam consumables, prenatal supplements, and related products) and Medical Diagnostics (COVID-19, drug testing — urine and oral, influenza, strep, RSV, hepatitis, mononucleosis, UTI/urinalysis, and more). We intentionally stay focused in these two areas rather than trying to be a general-line distributor.

Possibly. If a product falls within our two categories, contact us and we'll let you know if we can source it. We regularly add products as our supplier relationships expand, and client requests are one of the primary ways we identify what to add next.

Yes. We carry several combo configurations including COVID + Flu A/B, COVID + Flu + RSV, Strep A + Mono, and Flu A/B standalone. These are especially popular for respiratory illness season. You can find the full list in our Medical Diagnostics section, or include them in your quote request.

Shipping & Fulfillment

We ship to clinic locations throughout the United States. If you have a specific shipping requirement or a location that may be outside standard zones, mention it in your quote request and we'll confirm availability.

Fulfillment timelines vary by product and current stock levels, and will be confirmed as part of your quote. We aim to communicate expected ship dates clearly so your team can plan accordingly. If timing is critical, let us know upfront and we'll do everything we can to accommodate.

Working With GHLS

No online account creation is required. The process starts with a quote request — from there, your dedicated rep handles the relationship. You don't need to navigate a portal; we communicate directly and keep things simple.

Yes. Every clinic we work with is assigned a dedicated rep — not a shared inbox or call center queue. Your rep knows your account, your products, and your preferences. That relationship is part of what we sell.

No. We work with independent practices, small group clinics, urgent care centers, and large multi-site organizations. The savings model works at any volume because we're not building in overhead that requires you to buy a certain quantity to make sense of it. Submit a quote request and we'll give you honest pricing for your actual volume.
